relation_statement: Realized per-source sample counts must match the configured mixture ratios without repeated samples when a source-mixture dataset is used.
observable_signal: duplicate sample indices appearing near the end of training; realized per-source sample counts diverging from configured mixture ratios
validity_precondition: SourceMixtureDataset used without global_batch_size set in its config
evidence_from_issue: mixture 比例的 rounding error 导致训练末尾出现重复采样
evidence_from_fix: Missing global_batch_size in SourceMixtureDatasetConfig causes rounding error

relation_statement: The process-global Python RNG state must remain unchanged across dataset-config construction whenever later code relies on global random determinism.
observable_signal: global random module state (or a probe random draw) differing before vs after SourceMixtureDatasetConfig.build()
validity_precondition: SourceMixtureDatasetConfig.build() invoked in a process that subsequently uses the global random module
evidence_from_issue: 意外覆盖了 Python random 模块的全局 RNG seed，影响后续所有使用 random 的操作的确定性
evidence_from_fix: build() calls random.seed(self.seed), corrupting global RNG state

relation_statement: The number of loss-mask-excluded positions must match the number of padding tokens in each batch under padded fixed-sequence-length datasets.
observable_signal: label_mask dtype (int64 instead of bool) and count of False/zero mask entries vs padding-token count per batch
validity_precondition: NumpyPaddedFSLDataset with padding tokens present in the batch
evidence_from_issue: label_mask tensor 创建逻辑错误，导致 padding token 的 mask 不正确，影响 loss 计算
evidence_from_fix: torch.ones_like(input_ids) creates int64 mask, padded with pad_token_id instead of bool+False

relation_statement: Output-projection weight std at init must follow the depth-scaled initialization spec for Attention/GatedDeltaNet modules.
observable_signal: per-layer output-projection weight standard deviation at init vs the depth-scaled expected std
validity_precondition: Attention/GatedDeltaNet modules with depth-scaled output projection init configured
evidence_from_issue: depth-scaled output projection 初始化由于错误的自比较运算符（self-equality check）而从未生效
evidence_from_fix: 初始化使用了错误的 scale（self-equality check 使 depth-scaled init 从未生效）

relation_statement: The cumulative global FLOPs counter must be non-decreasing (never wrap or go negative) across steps in long-running large-model training.
observable_signal: global_train_flops decreasing or going negative; MFU discontinuity after ~107K steps on 7B models
validity_precondition: long runs where accumulated step FLOPs exceed the integer range of the counter
evidence_from_issue: 全局 FLOPS 计算在大规模训练时发生整数溢出，导致 MFU 计算结果错误
evidence_from_fix: global_train_flops: int overflows after ~107K steps for 7B models

relation_statement: Model parameters must equal the loaded checkpoint values after load_state_dict under FSDP FULL_SHARD, even when the load happens between forward and backward.
observable_signal: parameter checksum/norm after load_state_dict differing from checkpoint values (model keeps using old weights)
validity_precondition: FSDP FULL_SHARD with load_state_dict() called between forward and backward
evidence_from_issue: 在 forward 和 backward 之间调用 load_state_dict() 会被静默忽略
evidence_from_fix: 模型继续使用旧权重而非加载的 checkpoint 权重（load 被 FULL_SHARD 静默忽略）

relation_statement: Compiled execution must produce the same results as eager execution when torch.compile is applied over FSDP set_ operations.
observable_signal: divergence of forward outputs/gradients between torch.compile and eager runs on identical inputs
validity_precondition: torch.compile enabled on FSDP code paths using torch.ops.fsdp.set_
evidence_from_issue: torch.compile 的 CSE 优化错误地消除了 set_ 之后的重复表达式，导致静默产生错误结果
evidence_from_fix: FSDP 的 set_ 操作未被 functionalized，CSE 优化错误消除了重复表达式

relation_statement: All parameters must be cast to full precision so attention inputs share a single dtype when an FSDP-wrapped model runs in eval() with full-precision evaluation.
observable_signal: mixed fp32/bf16 dtypes among the q/k/v inputs to scaled_dot_product_attention during eval
validity_precondition: FSDP-wrapped model in model.eval() with full-precision eval expected
evidence_from_issue: 调用 model.eval() 时，某些参数未能正确 cast 到 full precision，attention 收到 fp32/bf16 混合输入但不报错
evidence_from_fix: FSDP full precision eval 下部分参数未 cast，导致精度混合且静默

relation_statement: The accumulated gradient must equal the sum of per-micro-batch reduced gradients when accumulating outside no_sync() with CPU offloading under FSDP.
observable_signal: gradient after N accumulation steps equals only the last micro-batch's gradient instead of the sum (mismatch vs no-offload baseline)
validity_precondition: FSDP gradient accumulation outside no_sync() with CPU offloading enabled
evidence_from_issue: gradient accumulation 且使用 CPU offloading 时结果不正确
evidence_from_fix: 直接使用新 reduce 的梯度替代累积梯度，而非叠加

relation_statement: Gradient reads and manual accumulation must be ordered after the corresponding reduce-scatter completes under FSDP+PP zero-bubble backward scheduling.
observable_signal: nondeterministic/corrupted gradient values across identical runs; gradient mismatch vs a synchronized baseline
validity_precondition: PP backward calling .grad() and accumulating manually with FSDP, root post-backward final callback skipped
evidence_from_issue: FSDP+PP stream sync bug: gradient corruption from race condition
evidence_from_fix: 遗漏了 FSDP 的 _root_post_backward_final_callback，导致 reduce-scatter 与梯度读取间的竞态条件

relation_statement: Gradient accumulation/reduction must be performed in fp32 even when reduce_dtype is bf16 under large-scale FSDP training.
observable_signal: reduced-gradient error vs an fp32-reduction reference growing with world size; training instability at 48x8 GPUs
validity_precondition: FSDP with bf16 reduce_dtype at large world size
evidence_from_issue: 梯度的 accumulation/reduction 操作在 bf16 精度下进行，大规模（48x8 GPU）训练变得不稳定
evidence_from_fix: FP32 accumulation of bf16 gradients needed; bf16 reduction精度不足导致不稳定

relation_statement: The clip coefficient must equal max_norm/(global_norm + eps) with eps added exactly once globally, and hence be invariant to world size, under DTensor gradient clipping.
observable_signal: clip_coef varying with world size for the same global gradient norm (epsilon multiplied by rank count)
validity_precondition: gradient clipping over DTensor/FSDP-sharded gradients
evidence_from_issue: 1e-6 在每个 rank 上各加了一次（而非全局加一次），导致 clip coefficient 随 world size 变化
evidence_from_fix: epsilon added per-rank instead of once in clip_coef = max_norm / (total_norm + 1e-6)

relation_statement: The gathered state_dict must contain every model parameter key under FSDP use_orig_params=True with FULL_SHARD.
observable_signal: missing parameter keys when diffing the inner-module state_dict key set against the model's full parameter set
validity_precondition: FSDP with use_orig_params=True + FULL_SHARD, state_dict taken from the inner module
evidence_from_issue: inner module 的 state_dict 缺少部分子模块的参数
evidence_from_fix: use_orig_params=True + FULL_SHARD 下 gathered state dict 缺参数，而 wrapped model 的 state_dict 正确

relation_statement: Recomputed activations must have the same dtype as the original forward activations during activation-checkpointing recomputation under FSDPv2.
observable_signal: recomputed activation dtype float32 while saved metadata records bfloat16 during recomputation
validity_precondition: activation checkpointing recomputation passing through FSDPv2 _pre_forward
evidence_from_issue: recomputation 阶段跳过了 dtype casting，recomputed activation 是 float32 而 saved metadata 记录的是 bfloat16
evidence_from_fix: _pre_forward hook 在 recomputation 阶段 skipped type casting

relation_statement: Parameter initialization values must be invariant to FSDP flatten/shard restructuring when param_init_fn and sync_module_states=True are used.
observable_signal: per-parameter init statistics differing from the unsharded baseline; training accuracy stuck at random (loss not decreasing)
validity_precondition: FSDP with param_init_fn and sync_module_states=True, re-initialization occurring after flatten/shard
evidence_from_issue: produces random accuracy (model not learning) 且不报错
evidence_from_fix: re-initialization 在 flatten/shard 后改变了参数 shape 导致 RNG 序列不同

relation_statement: Forward numerics must be invariant to whether the model was initialized on meta device then materialized or initialized directly on GPU before FSDP wrapping.
observable_signal: forward output divergence between meta-device-init and direct-GPU-init runs despite seemingly identical parameters/buffers
validity_precondition: HF model materialized from meta device, moved to GPU, then FSDP-wrapped
evidence_from_issue: meta device 初始化后再 move to GPU + FSDP wrap，与直接 GPU 初始化相比产生不同的数值结果
evidence_from_fix: 即使 buffers/parameters 看起来相同仍出现不同数值行为

relation_statement: Backward gradients must match the non-block-wrapped baseline within numerical tolerance when blocks are individually fully_shard()-ed under FSDP2.
observable_signal: text-layer gradient divergence vs unwrapped baseline (reproducible on a single GPU)
validity_precondition: FSDP2 block-level fully_shard() nesting with an outer full-model wrap
evidence_from_issue: backward 中 text layer 的 gradient 出现精度问题，单 GPU 也能复现
evidence_from_fix: 对 model block 逐个 fully_shard() 再 wrap 整个模型时出现 gradient precision degradation

relation_statement: Gradient-norm normalization must divide by the DP degree rather than the total world size when tensor parallelism is enabled.
observable_signal: grad norm (and tokens-per-GPU stats) scaling incorrectly with TP degree vs a TP=1 baseline
validity_precondition: TP enabled with gradient-norm scaling/clipping active
evidence_from_issue: TP 模式下 gradient norm scaler 错误地使用 world_size 而非 DP size 来做归一化
evidence_from_fix: 导致 gradient clipping 不正确，且 tokens-per-GPU 统计也错误

relation_statement: The final checkpoint for a given step must be saved exactly once and never overwrite an existing valid checkpoint after resuming from checkpoint.
observable_signal: duplicate save events targeting the same step / overwrite of an already-existing final checkpoint after restart
validity_precondition: training resumed from checkpoint and reaching the final step again
evidence_from_issue: trainer 尝试重复保存最终 checkpoint，可能覆盖已有的正确 checkpoint
evidence_from_fix: Fixed bug attempting to save duplicate final checkpoint on restart

relation_statement: RMSNorm must scale inputs by the root-mean-square sqrt(mean(x^2)), not the L2 norm sqrt(sum(x^2)), so output magnitude is independent of hidden dimension.
observable_signal: RMSNorm output standard deviation off by a factor of ~sqrt(hidden_dim) from the expected unit scale
validity_precondition: RMSNorm layers evaluated in forward
evidence_from_issue: RMSNorm uses L2 norm instead of root-mean-square — wrong normalization
evidence_from_fix: x.norm(2) is L2 norm (sqrt(sum(x^2))), not RMS (sqrt(mean(x^2)))

relation_statement: Every block's FFN projection weights must follow the intended init_normal distribution (nonzero std) at initialization when muP is enabled.
observable_signal: ff_proj weight standard deviation equal to 0 at init in every transformer block
validity_precondition: use_mup=true; applies to every block's ff_proj at construction
evidence_from_issue: ff_proj is silently zero-initialized via MuReadout when use_mup is enabled
evidence_from_fix: ff_proj constructed as MuReadout with readout_zero_init=True and reset_parameters skipped re-initializing it; fix always re-initializes ff_proj via init_normal

relation_statement: All-reduced optimizer metrics must be fully reduced and identical across ranks, which requires the reduction operands to live on the GPU device.
observable_signal: per-rank values of reduced per-param min/max/sum/norm metrics differing across ranks; metric tensors on CPU on the all_reduce path
validity_precondition: distributed training (FSDP/DDP) with optimizer metric collection enabled
evidence_from_issue: Optimizer metric tensors are kept on CPU, causing per-rank cross-device mismatch on the all_reduce path
evidence_from_fix: dist.all_reduce performed on CPU tensors ... returned partially-reduced values when ranks ended up on different devices; fix forces all metric tensors to the GPU device

relation_statement: Logged MoE load-balance and z-loss metrics must equal the all-reduced global mean rather than each rank's local value under data-parallel MoE training.
observable_signal: lb_batch_loss / moe_z_batch_loss differing across ranks at the same step; logged value equal to rank 0's local mini-batch value
validity_precondition: MoE block with load-balance loss or z-loss enabled and world_size > 1
evidence_from_issue: MoE load-balance and z-loss aux losses logged without all-reduce, so each rank reports its local value
evidence_from_fix: lb_batch_loss and moe_z_batch_loss were missed in the cross-rank reduction; wandb metric reflected only rank 0's mini-batch instead of the global mean

relation_statement: Each parameter's optimizer state must be restored to the same (correctly renamed) parameter after checkpoint reload when block_group_size changed between save and resume.
observable_signal: per-parameter optimizer state norms zeroed or attached to the wrong tensor after resume vs pre-save values
validity_precondition: FullCheckpointer.restore_checkpoint with load_optimizer_state=true and a different block_group_size than at save time
evidence_from_issue: rebuilds optim state with old parameter keys, dropping state for renamed params after block_group_size change
evidence_from_fix: FullCheckpointer threw away the og_keys_to_new mapping ... optimizer state for many params was either silently zeroed or attached to the wrong tensor

relation_statement: The memmap reader dtype must match the on-disk token dtype (uint32 when vocab_size > 2^16) when constructing the memmap dataset.
observable_signal: configured memmap dtype vs on-disk itemsize (file_size / token_count); max observed token id implausibly below vocab_size
validity_precondition: vocab_size > 65536 and dataset built without an explicit memmap_dtype
evidence_from_issue: DataConfig defaults memmap_dtype to uint16 silently, so vocab_size > 2^16 truncates token ids on load
evidence_from_fix: actual on-disk file was uint32 ... reading two-byte chunks silently produced wrong token ids without any type error

relation_statement: The realized warmup LR curve must match the reference trainer's schedule (start at 0.1*base_lr with linear ramp) for an equivalent config under the DeepSpeed backend.
observable_signal: logged learning rate at early warmup steps (0 instead of 0.1*base_lr) and ramp shape diverging from the reference schedule
validity_precondition: DeepSpeedTrainer used with warmup_steps > 0
evidence_from_issue: DeepSpeed warmup_min_lr=0 instead of base_lr*0.1, also missing warmup_type=linear
evidence_from_fix: warmup ramp starts from exactly 0 ... producing a different shape than the OLMo trainer for the equivalent config; silently mismatched warmup schedule

relation_statement: Post-RoPE q/k must be numerically identical to the reference (HF) implementation for the same weights and inputs, which requires applying RoPE in bf16 for Qwen3 configs.
observable_signal: bitwise/numeric diff of post-RoPE q/k vs the HF reference; RoPE computed in fp32 while reference uses bf16
validity_precondition: qwen3_* model factory with bf16 mixed-precision training and HF parity expected
evidence_from_issue: Qwen3 config defaults rope_full_precision=True, diverging from HF that applies RoPE in bf16
evidence_from_fix: fp32 round-off difference made post-RoPE q/k bit-non-identical and silently shifted training dynamics from the HF reference

relation_statement: The instance-source reader dtype must match the on-disk token dtype (uint32 for dolma2 vocab > 65535) when reading packed token files.
observable_signal: configured token_dtype vs on-disk itemsize; token-id distribution inconsistent with the tokenizer (garbage token streams)
validity_precondition: dolma2 tokenizer (vocab > 65535) with PerFileChunkedInstanceSourceConfig lacking an explicit token_dtype
evidence_from_issue: reads dolma2 (uint32) tokens with default uint16 dtype — silently produces garbage token ids
evidence_from_fix: Reading the file as uint16 reinterprets each pair of bytes as a different token, so the model trained on totally fabricated token streams without any error

relation_statement: Metrics accumulated over micro-batches must be divided by num_micro_batches so the logged value is invariant to grad_accum_steps.
observable_signal: logged BLT decoder losses scaling linearly with grad_accum_steps vs a grad_accum_steps=1 baseline
validity_precondition: TransformerBLTTrainModule with grad_accum_steps > 1
evidence_from_issue: BLT distill metric not divided by num_micro_batches when grad_accum_steps>1
evidence_from_fix: batch_metrics accumulated detached metric tensors across micro-batches without dividing by num_micro_batches, so logged losses were inflated by the gradient accumulation factor

relation_statement: Tokens belonging to different packed documents must not attend to each other when cu_doc_lens is provided to the attention backend.
observable_signal: a document's output changing when co-packed documents change; nonzero attention mass across document boundaries
validity_precondition: TEAttentionBackend selected with sequence packing (cu_doc_lens set)
evidence_from_issue: TE attention backend silently ignored cu_doc_lens — intra-doc masking not applied
evidence_from_fix: forward accepted cu_doc_lens / max_doc_len but did not pass them to the attn kernel; documents packed into a single sequence cross-attended each other

relation_statement: The gate projection (w_g) weights must be drawn from the intended trunc-normal initialization distribution, never left as uninitialized memory, at attention init.
observable_signal: w_g weight statistics (mean/std/extreme values) inconsistent with the trunc-normal spec; garbage values after meta-device materialization
validity_precondition: attention gating enabled (w_g not None) and init_attention executed
evidence_from_issue: Attention gate w_g never initialized — uses uninitialized memory
evidence_from_fix: init_attention initialized w_q/w_k/w_v ... but never touched the optional gate projection w_g; w_g.weight held whatever values torch.empty produced

relation_statement: Every term of the combined loss (hard CE, soft CE, z-loss) must remain attached to the autograd graph so backward carries nonzero gradient while the soft-CE branch is active.
observable_signal: grad_norm collapsing to ~0 while training loss stays > 0 as the soft-CE alpha decays
validity_precondition: soft_ce_alpha_start set (soft-CE branch executes) and LMHead returning ce_loss/z_loss as detached tensors
evidence_from_issue: soft_ce branch backprops only alpha*soft_ce — hard_ce gradient zeroed because output.ce_loss is detached
evidence_from_fix: combined_loss built from .detach()'d ce_loss/z_loss; as soon as alpha decayed to 0 the entire backward() saw zero gradient and grad_norm collapsed
